The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

The bug was in the `in_ready` logic: it used `!full` instead of `!closes` (where `closes = full || in_last`), so a last-byte beat with a non-full accumulator could be wrongly accepted while the output register was occupied and not draining, overwriting unread data. Changed line 30 to `assign in_ready = out_free || !closes;`.
